kammalakkhaṇa.p: [Kamma+lakkhaṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) Characterized by one’s actions. (2) The auspicious sign that is Kamma (deeds). (The recognized sign that is Kamma. Vimati). See original. (Ti) (3) One who has the recognized sign of Kamma. (One who is doing unwholesome deeds, is called Bāla. One who is doing wholesome deeds, is called Paṇḍita. Therefore that person has the recognized sign of Kamma (Kammalakkhaṇa)).
a: ကမ္မလက္ခဏ(န)

(၁)ကံ၏သဘော။(၂)ကံသည်သာလျှင် မှတ်သားအပ်သော အမှတ်အသား။(ကံသည်သာလျှင် မှတ်သားအပ်သော အမှတ်အသားရှိသော၊ ဝိမတိ)။ မူရင်းကြည့်ပါ။(တိ)(၃)မှတ်သားကြောင်း-သိကြောင်း-ကံရှိသော၊ သူ။(ဒုစရိုက်ကံပြုသူကို ဗာလ, သုစရိုက်ကံပြုသူကို ပဏ္ဍိတဟု သိရသည်၊ ထို့ကြောင့် ထိုသူများကို ကမ္မလက္ခဏ=မှတ်သားကြောင်း, သိကြောင်း ကံရှိသူများဟု ဆိုရသည်)။

B:
kammalakkhaṇa： kammalakkhaṇa（na）
ကမ္မလက္ခဏ（န）
[kamma+lakkhaṇa]
[ကမ္မ+လက္ခဏ]
K:
kammalakkhaṇa：ကမ္မလက္ခဏ （န）
[ကမ္မ+လက္ခဏ]
（၁） ကံ၏သဘော။ （၂） ကံသည်သာလျှင် မှတ်သားအပ်သော အမှတ်အသား။ （ကံသည်သာလျှင် မှတ်သားအပ်သော အမှတ်အသားရှိသော၊ ဝိမတိ）။ မူရင်းကြည့်ပါ။ （တိ） （၃） မှတ်သားကြောင်း-သိကြောင်း-ကံရှိသော၊ သူ။ （ဒုစရိုက်ကံပြုသူကို ဗာလ，သုစရိုက်ကံပြုသူကို ပဏ္ဍိတဟု သိရသည်၊ ထို့ကြောင့် ထိုသူများကို ကမ္မလက္ခဏ=မှတ်သားကြောင်း，သိကြောင်း ကံရှိသူများဟု ဆိုရသည်）။
CPD: kamma-lakkhaṇa , mfn. and n., 1. ( mfn. ) ( bhvr. ) having kamma as distinctive feature; 2. the distinctive feature of kamma; 3. ( t.t. Vin ) proceedings determined by implication, i.e., proceedings not named as Such in the Vin, but necessarily resulting from a prescription; — 1. exeg.: kammaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ saṅjānanakāraṇaṃ assā ti ~o, Mp ll 169, 4 ( ad A l 102, 2 ); kammaṃ lakkha- ṇam tassā ti ~o, Mp-ṭ ll 75, 20 ; attanā kataṃ ducca- ritakammaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ etassā ti ~o +, Ps-pṭ ll 195, 12,15 = Mp-ṭ lll 365, 27,28 ; — bhikkhu "~o bālo, ~o paṇḍito" ti yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāti, M l 220, 29,30 (Ps ll 262, 12 ) = A V 348, 14,15 ≠ M l 223, 4 = A V 351, 13 ≠ 1102, 2 qu. Ps ll 262, 12 ; — 2. ° -ppatta , mfn., having obtained the distinctive feature of kamma; tena katakammaṃ ~aṃ hotī ti, Ps-pṭ lll 414, 21 ; katakam- man ti paccayehi katabhāvaṃ upādāya vuttaṃ, na ~ato, Spk-pṭ ll 116, 22 ; — 3. ~añ ñ' eva pañcamaṃ, Vin V 222, 24 (... ti evaṃ avandiyakammaṃ anuñ- ñātaṃ taṃ ~añ ñ' eva pañcamaṃ imassa apaloka- nakammassa ṭhānaṃ hoti. tassa hi kammañ ñ' eva lakkhaṇaṃ, na osāraṇâdīni, tasmā ~an ti vuccati, Sp 1404, 14-17 ; kammam eva lakkhaṇan ti ~aṃ. osāraṇa- nissāraṇabhaṇḍukammâdayo viya kammañ ca hu- tvā aññañ ca nāmaṃ na labhati. kammam eva hu- tvā upalakkhīyatī ti ~an ti vuccati, Sp-ṭ lll 493, 12-14 ; kammañ ñ' eva lakkhaṇan ti imina osāraṇâdivasena gahitāvasesānaṃ sabbesaṃ apalokanakammassa sāmaññalakkhaṇavasena gahitattā kammañ ñ' eva lakkhanam assā ti ~an ti nibbacanaṃ, Vmv ll 317, 12 - 14) qu. Pālim 402, 11-13 "thus the proceedings to put a monk into the position of not being honoured ( by the nuns ) has been prescribed (Vin ll 261, 33 -262, 14 ). These proceedings determined by implication ( constitute ) the fifth instance, in which this apalokanakamma is appro- priate. For the legal proceedings ( concerning ) this ( par- ticular apalokanakamma) is only indicated, and not as osāraṇa etc. ( explicitly named in the Vin ) therefore it is called "proceedings determined by implication;" Sp 1412, 11 ; idañ ( i.e. avandiyakamma) ca ~aṃ nāma bhikkhunīmūlakaṃ paññattaṃ. api ca bhikkhūnam pi labbhati, Kkh 132, 12 foll. (~aṃ osāraṇâdayo viya kammañ ca hutvā aññañ ca nāmaṃ na labhati, kammam eva hutvā lakkhīyatī ti ~an ti attho, Kkh-ṭ 417, 24-27 ) = Sp 1405, 14 foll.; Vin-vn 2989; 3005; 3010; Sp 405, 14 ; 1412, 11 ; ~aṃ manasikaroti, 601, 10 (kam- mānaṃ sabhāvaṃ, Vjb 203, 6 ; Sp-ṭ ll 358, 24 ); kam- mam eva hutvā upalakkhīyatī ti ~aṃ. hetupaccay- âdilakkhaṇamutto hi sabbo paccayaviseso tattha saṅgayhati, Vjb 579, 25 -580, 2 ; — ° -pañcama , mfn., having ~ as the fifth; apalokanakammaṃ hi ~aṃ, Vin-vn 2986; — ° -vinicchaya , m., description of pro- ceedings determined by implication; pāḷimuttako pi ~o, Sp 1405, 14 qu. Vmv ll 317, 16 foll. = Pālim 403, 11 ; — ° -ekadesa , m., part of the ~; taṃ apalokanakammas- sa ~aṃ ṭhapetvā, Vjb 580, 20 ; — Rem.: The principle of interpretion by means of lakkhaṇas given in the text of the Vin particularly in the vinītavatthus, is explained Sp 272, 2-13 : lakkhaṇena vinayadharā āyatiṃ vina- yaṃ vinicchinissanti, Sp 272, 7 .[[side 255]]
